skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Spellbreaker
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spellbreaker. A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.
skins.quote: Beneath the gaze of justice, evil tumbles into the abyss.

skins.name: Ethereal Harmony
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Ethereal Harmony. Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.
skins.quote: 'Close your eyes. Imagine you have arrived at the end of time. There is nobody there. Only the sun, the moons, and the instruments. Then, you hear music, and you cannot help but open your eyes. Welcome to the concert, just for you.'
